title: Deduplicated benchmark for smartphone conjunctival anaemia detection in children (CP-AnemiC): code, duplicate map and results
description: Code, duplicate map (meta_groups.csv) and out-of-fold predictions for the article Data leakage inflates smartphone conjunctival pallor anaemia detection in children: a deduplicated benchmark of colour features versus lightweight CNNs on CP-AnemiC. Includes the SHA-256 + perceptual-hash duplicate audit of CP-AnemiC (710 rows, 472 unique images), colour-feature classifiers with nested repeated cross-validation, lightweight CNNs (PyTorch/CUDA and Keras) with ONNX/TFLite FP32/FP16/INT8 export and latency measurements, SHAP and Grad-CAM explainability, WHO-2024 threshold sensitivity analysis, per-seed CNN results, figures and a CLAIM 2024 / TRIPOD+AI reporting map. Development phase of a system intended for children aged 6-59 months in Puno, Peru.

creators.name: Arce Apaza, Bisleyn de la Flor

notes: The CP-AnemiC images are not redistributed here; download them from Mendeley Data (CC BY 4.0). meta_groups.csv and the result tables are derived from CP-AnemiC and released under CC BY 4.0; the code is MIT.
